text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, while I'm out shopping with Sakura Chiyono O…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Oho? What's happening over there?

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Step right up and try your luck with our New Year's raffle! This year's grand prize is a hot spring vacation for two!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: First-prize winners get a deluxe carrot hamburger steak! Second-prize winners get a bushel of carrots! And third-prize winners can take home a single carrot!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Don't let this opportunity pass you by! Get a ticket now and spin for your chance to win!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ooh, they're holding a raffle.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Wait a sec! Trainer, didn't we get a raffle ticket earlier when we bought that cleat polish?
choice_data_list: Do you want to give the raffle a try?
Do you want to give the raffle a try?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I do, but it'll be so disappointing if I get my hopes up and then don't win anything…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: So I'm thinking… how about we do it together?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: If we make it a joint effort, I feel like it'll be easier to accept the results even if they're bad, you know? Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I accept Sakura Chiyono O's offer, and we turn the lever together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A small plastic ball drops from the tumbler's opening…

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Holy mackerel! We've got ourselves a grand-prize winner! Come and get the coupon for your hot spring vacation! Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Wh-what?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Omigosh, Trainer! We did it! We got th-th-the—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Y-yeah! The grand prize! We got the grand prize!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: The grand prize, the grand prize!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Chiyono O suddenly grabs my hands and starts jumping up and down in sheer excitement.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Congrats to you too! Hehe! I can barely believe it! We got the best prize of them all!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Hahaha! You two are just like a cute pair of siblings! I assume you'll be going on the trip together, then?

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Hahaha! You two are just like a cute pair of sisters! I assume you'll be going on the trip together, then?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Huh? Wait, what?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: This ticket isn't for just one person? I can go too?

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Of course! The shopping district isn't so stingy as to only offer a hot spring vacation coupon for one!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Wow! That's so generous!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I-in that case! Trainer, is it okay if I go with you too?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I thought the coupon was just for one person, so I was going to let you have it, but I'd love to go together if that's all right…
choice_data_list: Sure! But are you sure you want to go with me?
Sure! But are you sure you want to go with me?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Absolutely! In fact, there's no one else I'd rather go with!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: When do you think we should go? We're still so busy right now, so…
choice_data_list: Guess we'll have to wait until everything's settled down.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Sounds good! Hehe. Once we pick a date to go, I'll make a full schedule for our trip!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I haven't been to a hot spring since I went with my family as a kid! I hope they have karaoke machines there!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I recognize the inn on the coupon. Apparently, many Umamusume like to go there to refresh themselves in their rejuvenating hot spring.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Once everything's calmed down, it'll make a nice, relaxing reward for all of Sakura Chiyono O's hard work.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Looks like we have another first-prize winner! Congratulations! You get one deluxe carrot hamburger steak!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Whoa, it looks delicious! Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Haha! No need for thanks. Your luck got you that prize, not me.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: I can tell you're a hard worker from a glance, and you know what they say—good things come to those who wait!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Ehehe…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Is that so? Th-thank you…
choice_data_list: He's right. You're a very diligent worker.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Not you too, Trainer! Don't go flattering me out of nowhere!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I know I work hard, but I'm nothing special…
choice_data_list: You don't think so? I think you are.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Eep! Cut that out already…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: U-urgh…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: You're special too, just so you know!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I bet that's why we got the first prize together! It wasn't just my luck. It was our luck!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: The combined luck of a special person like you and a kinda-special someone like me is what won us the prize!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: So, um! Yeah. Thanks for contributing!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Chiyono O presses her hands to her bright-red face and flees from the scene.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As an apology for embarrassing her, I let her have the raffle prize all to herself.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: We got a second-prize winner! It's your lucky day! You're going home with a bushel of carrots!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Whoa! I can't even see the bottom of the box, it's so packed with carrots!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: We could eat nothing but carrots for two whole days with this!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Yep! Hehe. You can leave the cooking to me. I'm a master at making the carrot chanko hot pot my mom taught me!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I'll make sure you're fed noon, evening, and night for a whole day! You won't have to lift a finger.
choice_data_list: Wait, separate meals for evening and night?!
Wait, separate meals for evening and night?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Oh… Oops, you're right. I'd just get in your way if I stopped by so many times.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: And it'd be rude of me to barge in on you in your room late at night…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Okay, change of plans! I have an idea!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, later that evening…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Traaainer! Would you mind opening the door?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Phew! Here's your delivery of my special chanko!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Your evening and night portions are both in there, so go ahead and dig in!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She places the biggest pot I've ever seen in my life on my desk. A peek inside reveals a steaming hot pot brimming with carrots cut into beautiful little roses…

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Would you lookie here! You've won the third prize! Here's your carrot!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Oh, I recognize this variety of carrot! Everyone was losing their minds over it a while ago. It's a Sweety-Sweet Carrot, right?

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: You've got quite an eye, miss!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hehe, yeah! They had an entire special about it on TV yesterday! Apparently, these carrots taste like pure sugar on your tongue!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hehe… Hmm… Sweety-Sweet… I can't wait to taste it…
choice_data_list: You can have it, Chiyono O.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Can I?! Really?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I-I mean… Urgh… Sorry for getting all worked up. Is there a hole anywhere I can crawl into?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Chiyono O's cheeks redden by the second. Despite her reward consisting of only one carrot, she still graciously accepts it.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Ohhh, tough luck! Looks like you pulled a blank one! Take this pack of tissues as a consolation prize.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Aw, man. That was a total bust… I'm sorry, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: But still…
choice_data_list: Since it was a joint effort, we can accept any result, right?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hehe… Oh, right. I did say that. I guess that means we can split the disappointment between us too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sharing the burden of disappointment, Sakura Chiyono O and I quietly return to campus.
